en-GB.name: Dino Book Reader
en-GB.summary: Free picture-book stories, read aloud for children.
en-GB.description: Dino Book Reader reads free children's stories aloud. Ask for a book by name and listen. You can pause, carry on, skip to the next story or start again. There is nothing to sign in to and nothing to buy.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Dino Book Reader to read Goldilocks
Alexa, ask Dino Book Reader to play the little red hen

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: No account linking, no sign-in and no purchases. Say 'Alexa, open Dino Book Reader' to hear the list of books, then 'read <a book from the list>'. Pause, resume, next, previous, start over and stop all work with the standard Alexa commands. The books come from the live store list, so a book appears here only once its listening track is published.
